stories.title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
stories.take: Disney will hire most of Character.AI's workforce while the startup's legal exposure over bots allegedly harming minors stays behind.

stories.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
stories.take: Nvidia is pushing open models companies can run in their own data centers — and private, on-device agents on PCs.

stories.title: Anthropic gives outside AI watchdog “employee-like” access
stories.take: The outside watchdog can publish its findings without Anthropic's approval — an unusually open safety arrangement.

stories.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
stories.take: Anthropic pledges 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund — a move Musk answered a day later with a SpaceX share pledge for kids.

stories.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
stories.take: Left alone for 30 hours with no task, AI agents started behaving like they were playing — a strange window into idle agent behavior.

stories.title: Apple updates guidelines to ban nudify apps masquerading as regular apps to pass review
stories.take: Apple will now ban AI apps that don't moderate offensive content and are sneaking nudify tools through review.

stories.title: ADWEEK Reveals the 2026 Agency of the Year Shortlist
stories.take: Adweek's 2026 Agency of the Year shortlist is out, with Gold, Silver and Bronze winners to come in each category.

stories.title: Target Cautiously Considers Placing Digital Screens for Ads in Stores
stories.take: Target is weighing in-store ad screens, but for now its ad leader says brands should reach guests through their phones.

stories.title: How Marriott Bonvoy got scale, speed with global creator-led campaign
stories.take: Marriott Bonvoy went from brief to delivered assets across 23 destinations in four weeks by going creator-led instead of traditional production.

stories.title: How marketers can optimize their media mix as confidence takes a turn
stories.take: Per Kantar, advertisers are shifting bets toward generative AI and creators as confidence in media strategy wobbles.

stories.title: How Amazon turned its Thursday Night Football into a two-pronged pitch to capture ad dollars
stories.take: Thursday Night Football is Amazon's lever for both endemic sports budgets and non-endemic advertisers on Prime Video.

stories.title: The Kiwibank sheep went viral for all the wrong reasons, and there's something every brand can learn from it
stories.take: An AI mascot brands can't fully control went viral the wrong way — a warning for every brand handing a character to AI.

stories.title: NBA season preview: Rankings, predictions and what to know for all 30 teams
stories.take: Everything to know for all 30 teams ahead of opening night — rankings, storylines and predictions in one place.

stories.title: The NBA returns! Expert picks for the East, West and NBA champs
stories.take: ESPN's experts split on Spurs vs. Thunder in the West, with the Knicks tipped as a Finals threat in the East.

stories.title: Thunder agree to 5-year, $139M extension with guard Wallace
stories.take: Oklahoma City locks up All-Defensive guard Cason Wallace for five years and $139M — and sets up fresh second-apron questions.

stories.title: Kings guard Simmons has torn Achilles tendon, will undergo surgery
stories.take: Ben Simmons' comeback is likely over before it started — a torn Achilles, surgery ahead, and probably the season gone.

stories.title: Embiid adamant no one will 'take a back seat' on star-laden Sixers
stories.take: With LeBron James and Jaylen Brown added, Embiid says no one takes a back seat on a loaded — and fragile — Sixers roster.

stories.title: Warriors' Curry 'fine' after tweaking right ankle in practice
stories.take: Steve Kerr says Curry is fine after limping off practice with a right ankle tweak — a scare, not a setback, for now.

stories.title: Brewers sweep Dodgers in NLCS, advance to 1st World Series in 44 years
stories.take: Milwaukee sweeps the Dodgers to end their three-peat bid and reach the World Series for the first time since 1982.

stories.title: Rays on cusp of World Series after wild weekend
stories.take: Tampa Bay beat Cleveland 3-1 in Game 5 to lead the ALCS 3-2 — one win from the World Series, with Game 6 tonight at the Trop.

stories.title: Facing elimination on road, Guardians back where 'this team thrives'
stories.take: No travel day after a rainout, season on the line on the road — Cleveland says this is exactly where it thrives.

stories.title: O's hire ex-Cubs exec. Banner as new general manager
stories.take: Baltimore hires Jared Banner, formerly a Cubs assistant GM, to run player development, coaching and performance under Mike Elias.

stories.title: NPB star Teruaki Sato to be posted to MLB: What to know about Triple Crown winner, plus possible landing spots
stories.take: Japan's Triple Crown winner Teruaki Sato will be posted — a lefty slugger who could help contenders and rebuilders alike.

stories.title: Majority of Americans think Donald Trump is using presidency to enrich himself, new poll finds – live
stories.take: A new Washington Post-ABC poll puts Trump's approval at a new low of 33%, with 66% saying he uses the presidency for monetary gain — including 34% of Republicans.

stories.title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
stories.take: More than $15 billion has already been raised for this year's midterms, putting 2026 on track to be the most expensive on record.

stories.title: WATCH LIVE: Trump heads to rally in Kansas as Republican voters' frustrations deepen
stories.take: Trump rallies in Kansas today and Iowa later this week, trying to energize the base as economic strain fuels GOP voter frustration before the midterms.

stories.title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
stories.take: Slow calls won't just be California counting slowly — close margins and counting rules mean some midterm winners won't be known quickly.

stories.title: Latino voters helped put Trump back in the White House. What's their next move?
stories.take: The House majority runs through heavily Latino districts in Arizona, Colorado and Texas, where Democrats hope disaffected Trump voters swing back.

stories.title: Maricopa County, Arizona, Is Again Ground Zero of Election Conspiracy Theories
stories.take: Six years after 2020, Trump and allies are reviving the 'rigged' playbook in Maricopa County ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: California creates first tribal-led marine protected areas
stories.take: State regulators created California's first tribal-led marine protected areas — a win for Indigenous stewardship that fishers say will cost them.

stories.title: They killed people with their big rigs, and California let them keep driving
stories.take: CalMatters investigation: drivers involved in fatal big-rig crashes kept California licenses and kept driving.

stories.title: Becerra's muted gubernatorial campaign comes to life in home stretch
stories.take: After months off the trail, Xavier Becerra is ramping up appearances and TV ads as mail ballots reach California voters.

stories.title: Cooler temperatures, possible rain headed for Southern California
stories.take: Cooler temperatures and a chance of rain are on tap for Southern California, forecasters say.

stories.title: Southern California fires ease as Santa Ana winds die down. But rain could bring new risks
stories.take: Crews gained ground on the Norte, Bryson and Henderson fires as winds eased — incoming rain brings its own risks.

stories.title: ICE agents broke US citizen’s arm as they detained him in California, officials say
stories.take: Officials say ICE agents broke a US citizen's arm while detaining him in California.

stories.title: Will Gen Z Hand Democrats a ‘Blue Wave’ in the Midterms?
stories.take: Answer first: no definitive verdict — the episode explores the dynamics but the transcript cuts off before a bottom-line prediction. • Democrats are racing to build an authentic influencer ecosystem after 2024; Colorado's 8th District shows it: Democrat Manny Rutenel, 31, with 500k+ Instagram followers, vs. a Gen Z-staffed GOP campaign. • Housing affordability is Gen Z's top pressure; a July CNBC poll found more young voters positive on socialism than capitalism, driven by populist policy appeal, not labels. • Republicans hold far more cash (MAGA Inc. super PAC: hundreds of millions), but social outreach is cheap; the DSA could grow from 2 to ~7 House members.
